You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
from collections import deque
def comps(g,bg):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b,g[a][b]))
                    for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+di,b+dj
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
def sig(cl):
    rs=[a for a,b,_ in cl]; cs=[b for a,b,_ in cl]
    base=tuple(sorted((a-min(rs),b-min(cs)) for a,b,_ in cl))
    cols=tuple(sorted(c for _,_,c in cl))
    return cols,base
I1,O1=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
h,w=len(I1),len(I1[0]); bg=I1[0][0]
c1=comps(I1,bg)
for cl in c1:
    s=sig(cl)
    matches=[]
    for dr,dc in [(dr,dc) for dr in [-h,h] for dc in [-w,w]]+[(0,0)]:
        tgt=[(a+dr,b+dc) for a,b,_ in cl]
        if all(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w for a,b in tgt) and \

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g)
    multi=[(c,sorted(cl)) for c,cl in cs if len(cl)>1]

    for mcol,(mi,mj) in [(g[a][b],(a,b)) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if g[a][b]!=bg and (a,b) not in multiset]:

        for c,pts in multi:
            nd=min(abs(mi-a)+abs(mj-b) for a,b in pts)
            if best is None or nd<best[0]: best=(nd,c,pts)
        nd,c,pts=best
        tgt=min(pts,key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-mi)+abs(p[1]-mj),p))
        shift=(mi-tgt[0],mj-tgt[1])

            ni,nj=pi+shift[0],pj+shift[1]
            if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and res[ni][nj]==bg:
                res[ni][nj]=mcol

from collections import Counter,defaultdict,deque
inp=G['Demo pair 6 input']; out=G['Demo pair 6 output']
h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bg=5
cs=comps(inp); multi=[(c,cl) for c,cl in cs if len(cl)>1]
sing=[(inp[a][b],(a,b)) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if inp[a][b]!=bg and (a,b) not in set(p for _,pts in multi for p in pts)]
added=defaultdict(set)
for i in range(h):
    for j in range(w):
        if inp[i][j]==bg and out[i][j]!=bg: added[out[i][j]].add((i,j))
print('multi',multi)
print('singletons',sing)
# print added sets per marker
for mcol,pos in sing:
    print(mcol,pos,'->',sorted(added.get(mcol,[])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); b=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=b and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); pts=[]
                while q:
                    a,b2=q.popleft(); pts.append((a,b2))
                    for di,dj in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        p2,q2=a+di,b2+dj
                        if 0<=p2<h and 0<=q2<w and g[p2][q2]==c and (p2,q2) not in seen:
                            seen.add((p2,q2)); q.append((p2,q2))
                out.append((c,tuple(sorted(pts))))
    return b,out
def solve(I,O=None):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); b,cc=comps(I)
    singles={(pos):col for pos,col,p in [(p[0],p,0) for p in cc] if False}
    singles={p[0]:col for col,p in cc if len(p)==1}
    multis=[(col,p) for col,p in cc if len(p)>1]
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    # order markers by reading order; later overwrite earlier
    for mark in sorted(singles.items()):
        mpos,mcol=mark
        mr,mc_=mpos
        # nearest multi comp
        best=None
        for colC,pC in multis:
            ds=[abs(mr-a)+abs(mc_-b) for a,b in pC]
            dn=min(ds); pnn=pC[ds.index(dn)]
            (cnn,dnn,pnn_)=None,None,None
        # redo cleanly:
        best=None
        for colC,pC in multis:
            dmin,minp=min((abs(mr-a)+abs(mc_-b),k) for k,(a,b) in enumerate(pC))
            nd=dmin if best is None or dmin<best[0] else best[0]
            if nd==best[0]: continue
            best=(nd,[(colC,pC,k)],pC[minp])
        _,info,cn=best
        colC,pC,cn=info[0][0],info[0][1],info[2]
        # nearest cell of comp to marker
        dmin=min(abs(mr-a)+abs(mc_-b) for a,b in pC)
        kn=[k for k,(a,b) in enumerate(pC) if abs(mr-a)+abs(mc_-b)==dmin][0]
        a0,b0=pC[kn]
        v=(mr-a0, mc_-b0)
        cand=[]
        def fl(p,mode):
            if mode=='V': return (-p[0],p[1])
            if mode=='H': return (p[0],-p[1])
            return p
        for mode in ['V','H']:
            fp=fli:=lambda p:(-p[0],p[1]) if mode=='V' else lambda p:(p[0],-p[1])
            f=fl
            fp=[f(q) for q in pC]
            dk=(fp.index(f(cn)))
            dr,dc=mr-fp[dk][0], mc_-fp[dk][1]
            st=frozenset((a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in fp)
            inb=sum(1 for a,b in st if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w)
            cand.append((inb-inb, -sum(abs(dr)+abs(dc)), mode, inb, dr, dc))
        sc=max(cand,key=lambda t:t[1]*1e6+t[2])
        sc=sc if False else sc  # placeholder
        # rerank: max inb, then min |shift|
        cand.sort(key=lambda t:(-t[3], t[2]))
        mode,d_,_,inb,dr,dc=cand[0]
        fp=[f(q) for q in pC]
        fp={k for k in range(len(fp))}
        stamp={(a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in fp}
        stamp&={mpos}: set()
        for a,b in stamp:
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w: O[a][b]=mcol
    return O

# Hypothesis: identity-only translation: place copy of multi-comp so the nearest comp CELL lands on the marker cell.
# Test on all demos with that anchor, then extend to dihedral variants if needed.
def solve_ident(I):
    h_,w_=len(I),len(I[0])
    bgv,allc=comps(I)
    multis=[(p,c) for c,p in allc if len(p)>1]
    singles=[(pos,col) for col,p in allc if len(p)==1]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    def dist(m,pos): return abs(m[0]-pos[0])+abs(m[1]-pos[1])
    for m,c in sorted(singles,key=lambda t:t[0]):
        best=None
        for S_,sc in multis:
            dd=set()
            for q in S_: dd.add(dist(m,q))
            kn=min(S_,key=lambda q:dist(m,q))
            d=(m[0]-kn[0],m[1]-kn[1])
            st=frozenset((a+d[0],b+d[1]) for a,b in S_)
            ov=sum(1 for a,b in st if (a,b)!=m and 0<=a<h_ and 0<=b<w_ and I[a][b]!=bgv)
            # prefer nearest comp overall
            key=(dist(m,kn),ov,len(st))
            if best is None or key<best[0]:
                best=key,st,d,S_,sc
        _,st,d,S_,sc=best
        for a,b in st:
            if (a,b)!=m and 0<=a<h_ and 0<=b<w_: O[a][b]=c
    return O
for dp in range(1,9):
    res=solve_ident(G[f'Demo pair {dp} input'])
    exp=G[f'Demo pair {dp} output']
    print('demo',dp,'match:',res==exp)

    bgv,allc=comps(I)
    singles=[(pos,col) for col,p in allc if len(p)==1]

    for m,c in sorted(singles,key=lambda tt:(tt[0],tt[1])):
        best=None
        for sc,S_ in allc:
            if len(S_)<=1: continue
            nf=dih(norm(S_)); base=S_
            for fm in nf:

                offs=frozenset((m[0]-p[0], m[1]-p[1]) for p in fm)
                for dd in offs:

                    cost=sum(1 for a,b in st if inb(a,b) and (a,b)!=m and I[a][b]!=bgv)

                    key=(cost-cover,cost)
                    if best is None or key<best[0]:
                        best=(key,st,sc,fm,dd)
        if best is None: continue
        _,st,sc,fm,dd_=best
        for a,b in st:
            if inb(a,b) and (a,b)!=m: O[a][b]=c

# Careful about the single-cell marker: it IS a color of its own component; we don't have separate pos/color.
# Marker position = p[0] where len(p)==1. Markers' colors come from comps: for each single comp, c = color.
def solve(I):
    h_,w_=len(I),len(I[0])
    bgv,allc=ccomp(I)
    singles=[(p,c) for c,p in allc if len(p)==1]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    def inb(a,b): return 0<=a<h_ and 0<=b<w_
    results=[]
    for m,c in sorted(singles,key=lambda t:(t[0][0],t[0][1])):
        best=None
        for sc,S_ in allc:
            if len(S_)<=1: continue
            nf=dih(norm(S_)); base=S_
            for fm in nf:
                for q,fq in zip(fm,base):
                    dd=(m[0]-fq[0], m[1]-fq[1])
                    st=frozenset((aa+dd[0],bb+dd[1]) for aa,bb in base)
                    ov=sum(1 for a,b in st if inb(a,b) and (a,b)!=m and I[a][b]!=bgv)
                    key=ov
                    if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,st,sc,q)
        if best is None: continue
        _,st,sc,q=best
        for a,b in st:
            if inb(a,b) and (a,b)!=m: O[a][b]=c
    return O
for dp in range(1,9):
    res=solve(G[f'Demo pair {dp} input'])
    print(dp,res==G[f'Demo pair {dp} output'])

added={(i,j,O[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if O[i][j]!=I[i][j]}
for c,mk in sing:
    ac=min(big,key=lambda bc: min(max(abs(a-mk[0]),abs(b-mk[1])) for a,b in bc[1]))[1][0]
    dr = 1 if mk[0]>ac[0] else (-1 if mk[0]<ac[0] else 0)
    dc = 1 if mk[1]>ac[1] else (-1 if mk[1]<ac[1] else 0)
    offs=sorted((i-mk[0],j-mk[1]) for i,j,v in added if v==c)
    print('marker',mk,'col',c,'anchor',(ac[0],ac[1]),'dir',dr,dc,'count',len(offs),'shape',offs)

steps.input:
def solve(k):
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    bgv,comps=ccomp(I)
    sing=set((color,p[0]) for color,p in comps if len(p)==1)
    bigs=[(c,p) for c,p in comps if len(p)>1]
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[[I[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    # hypothesis: each marker gets the nearest big comp mirrored about the marker (marker becomes image of anchor).
    for color,(mr,mc) in sing.items():
        best=None; bd=10**9
        for cc,pb in bigs:
            ds=min(abs(ap[0]-mr)+abs(ap[1]-mc) for ap in pb)
            if ds<bd: bd=ds; best=(cc,pb)
        if not best: continue
        cc,pb=best
        ap=min(pb, key=lambda q:(abs(q[0]-mr)+abs(q[1]-mc)))
        shift=(mr-ap[0], mc-ap[1])
        cp={(p[0]+shift[0],p[1]+shift[1]) for p in pb}
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                p=(i,j)
                if p in cp: out[i][j]=color
    return out
ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,9)]:
    o=solve(k); print(k,'match' if o==G[k+' output'] else 'NO')
    ok = ok and o==G[k+' output']
print('ALL',ok)

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for mm in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h_,w_=mm[1],int(mm[2]),int(mm[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[mm.end():].split('\n')[:h_]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w_ and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

print('comp0 cells',[(i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]==0])

import os,re,collections,itertools
from collections import Counter,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h_,w_=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h_]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w_ and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def cc(I,bgv=None):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    bgv=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if I[i][j]!=bgv and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=I[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and I[na][nb]==c and (na,nb) not in seen:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
                out.append((c,tuple(sorted(cells))))
    return out,bgv
def nf(cells):
    mi=min(c[0] for c in cells); mj=min(c[1] for c in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((c[0]-mi,c[1]-mj) for c in cells))
# Hypothesis: marker M with color c_M. Find nearest big comp P (min dist between marker cell and comp cells).

    g=math.gcd(abs(adv[0]),abs(adv[1])) or 1

    # normalize ahead sign: points away from marker => use -av
